description: This file configures module dependencies and initializations for a Backbone.js based application using Require.js. It sets up the module paths and dependencies, then initializes the application by starting Backbone.history and creating the main application view.

methods.name: require.config
methods.description: Configures module dependencies and path mappings for Require.js.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Loads and initializes modules: backbone, views/app, routers/router, then creates instances to start the application.

methods.name: Backbone.history.start
methods.description: Begins monitoring URL changes for the Backbone router.
